jobs.title: Data Analyst, Customer Insights — New Grad
jobs.description:
Jobright is your personal AI job search agent that transforms the way you do job search from solo, time-consuming efforts to a fast, expert-guided journey, simplifying every job search step and accelerating your route to the best job outcomes. Why Join Us

• Build real, production AI agents used by real users
• High ownership and impact
• Work at the intersection of AI, agents, and product
• Shape how people experience AI-driven job search

Responsibilities

• Analyze customer behavior, engagement, retention, and satisfaction
• Combine quantitative data with surveys and support feedback
• Build customer segments, dashboards, and recurring reports
• Identify recurring pain points and unmet customer needs
• Measure the impact of customer-experience initiatives
• Present findings and recommendations to cross-functional teams
Qualification

Required

• Recent graduate in Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Psychology, Business, or a related field
• Strong SQL and spreadsheet skills
• Understanding of statistics and customer-behavior analysis
• Strong written and verbal communication skills
• Ability to work effectively in a remote environment

Preferred

• Experience with surveys, segmentation, or customer research
• Familiarity with Python, Tableau, Looker, or product analytics tools
• Experience analyzing support, CRM, or user-feedback data
• Interest in consumer technology and AI products

jobs.title: PK3-Early Childhood Education Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Vanguard University

Position Summary

The Program Coordinator serves a vital role in advancing Vanguard University's mission by supporting the School of Education's commitment to preparing Christ-centered educators who will positively impact schools, communities, and future generations. Reporting to the Chair of Early Childhood Education and working closely with the Assistant Director of the Graduate Program in Education, the Coordinator provides comprehensive administrative, operational, and student support that contributes to the successful delivery of the Early Childhood Education (ECE) and PK-3 Credential programs. This position collaborates closely with faculty, the Credential Analyst/Student Teacher Coordinator, and university partners to promote student success, maintain program excellence, and ensure efficient day-to-day operations. Through exceptional service, organization, and collaboration, the Program Coordinator helps foster a supportive learning environment that reflects the University's values of academic excellence, Christian faith, and servant leadership.

POSITION DUTIES

In collaboration with the ECE Chair, coordinate all accreditation activities and document submissions to the Commission on Teacher Credentialing (CTC).
Coordinate with the GPE Office and Assistant Director of Graduate Education the admission process into the PK3 credential program.
Coordinate advising and tracking of ECE and PK3 students throughout the program.
Coordinate with ECE Chair and Assistant Director effective credential orientations for new PK3 and ECE students each semester.
Assist the ECE Chair in preparing and managing budgets for the ECE and PK3 programs.
Advise the Chair and faculty regarding students' needs for remediation and intervention.
Work with the Chair and faculty in reviewing program changes and curriculum development.
Provide general troubleshooting of all departmental systems and policies.
Maintain ECE and PK3 websites and handbook.
Coordinate course schedule revisions, catalog editing, adjunct hiring logistics, and providing professional development for program staff.
Other duties as assigned including mandatory particaption in the Universities annual commencment ceremonies.

Skills & Qualifications

Bachelor's degree required, Master's degree preferred, with program management experience, preferably in educational institutions.
Knowledge of teacher certification and organization of school districts.
Ability to learn and represent policies, procedures, and regulations of the Program as well as CTC regulations and the various accrediting bodies associated with the Program.
Ability to coordinate with the staff team in excellent customer service and resolving student issues.
Excellent critical thinking skills and the ability to communicate effectively to the public, students, faculty, staff and administration in various formats.
Efficient computer proficiency in Microsoft Office and use of databases
Organizational and administrative skills; the ability to coordinate multiple tasks concurrently.
Ability to initiate systems and process for effective program management, program marketing and advisement.
Knowledge and acceptance of principles and philosophies of Vanguard University, its programs and requirements.

SALARY

This is a non-exempt, full-time, benefit-eligible position. Expected Pay Range: $28.00 - $29.50 per hour

Placement within the salary range is commensurate upon education and experience. Posted salary range reflects anticipated hiring scale for the position. Vanguard University also offers a very competitive and generous benefits package.

To apply, please visit: https://recruiting.myapps.paychex.com/appone/MainInfoReq.asp?R_ID=7196888

jobs.title: Project Coordinator - AI & Data Projects
jobs.description:
About Our Client
The organization operates in the artificial intelligence research and data operations sector, supporting complex AI training, human-data, and research programs. It facilitates collaboration among program leadership, research teams, and domain experts to coordinate large-scale, cross-functional initiatives focused on advancing AI capabilities and data-driven research.
About the Opportunity
The Project Coordinator - AI & Data Projects
plays a central role in coordinating AI research, training, and data programs. This position serves as a key liaison between leadership, research teams, and domain experts, ensuring workflows, requirements, schedules, and project communications remain organized and aligned.
The role supports project execution, expert network growth, operational consistency, and continuous improvement across dynamic AI and data initiatives.
Responsibilities
• Serve as the primary point of contact for AI and data projects, managing daily workflows and operational activities
• Facilitate communication among program leads, research teams, and domain experts
• Translate leadership objectives into clear guidelines, requirements, and actionable updates for expert teams
• Support the onboarding and engagement of domain experts as projects expand
• Participate in weekly business reviews, document meeting notes, track action items, and coordinate project calls
• Monitor project quality, identify operational issues, and communicate findings to relevant stakeholders
• Assist in developing, documenting, and refining project processes and operating guidelines
• Identify risks, dependencies, and roadblocks and coordinate resolution efforts
• Track project timelines, deliverables, and performance metrics using Google Sheets and Excel
• Maintain accurate project documentation and ensure timely communication of project updates
• Adapt to changing priorities, project requirements, and operational workflows
• Support continuous improvements in project operations, processes, and team coordination
Requirements
• United States-based
• Preferably a STEM or quantitatively oriented educational background
• Minimum of 3 years of experience in project coordination, project management, or related roles involving large or cross-functional teams
• Direct experience with AI training-data, human-data, data operations, evaluation, or research programs
• Proven ability to coordinate complex projects involving multiple stakeholders and distributed teams
• Proficiency with data management tools, including Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets
• Familiarity with SQL
• Preferred knowledge of programming or software development concepts
• Strong organizational, communication, and team leadership skills
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently in a dynamic environment
Pay Range and Compensation Package
• $45 to $70 per hour

Equal Opportunity Statement: Our client is an equal opportunity employer. They celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or national origin.

Note: RemoteHunter is not the Employer of Record (EOR) for this role. Our purpose in this opportunity is to connect exceptional candidates with leading employers. We help job seekers worldwide discover roles that match their goals and guide them to complete their full application directly through the hiring company’s career page or ATS.
